summary: Bank7 Corp. filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing a September 3 amendment to its July 1 stock purchase agreement with the court-appointed receiver for the estate of KS StateBank v. Peters. Bank7 raised its cash bid to $88.96 million, reflecting a $91.0 million auction bid less a $2.04 million break-up fee credit, to acquire roughly 237,136 Century Financial shares, or about 71% of the New Mexico bank holding company. Closing awaits a court Sale Order and Federal Reserve approval.
